name: GameCase + SideStore
subtitle: GameCase AltStore Source.
description:
This is the AltStore Source for GameCase.

GameCase is a sideloading game container built for iOS game ports. Import a game IPA and its romfs datapack into the library, manage each game's own launcher settings in one place, and play - no jailbreak required.

apps.name: GameCase + SideStore
apps.subtitle: Import an IPA and its datapack - just play.
